stable.description: Stable channel accepts release versions only.

preview.description: Preview channel may accept RC/beta prereleases as well as stable releases.

publication.revisionPolicy: Internal rN labels may identify QA artifacts only. Any new public updater release must bump SemVer; publishable releases use r1.

integrity.privateKeyPolicy: Store only in protected release/CI secret storage; never commit or package it.
integrity.bootstrapPolicy: Public publishing remains blocked until a real GitHub repository, committed updater public key, package-lock.json and src-tauri/Cargo.lock are present.

lifecycle.signatureFailure: reject update and keep current version
lifecycle.pendingChanges: download may complete, but do not install/restart: native authority rechecks pending project changes immediately before install and any new staged change blocks installation
lifecycle.nonInstalledBuild: automatic updater disabled; only installed NSIS builds may configure or install updates
